title: Must / should
note: Obligation (must) and advice (should). Gap on modal. No have to yet. · Bank 48 items · flags: 2026-07-26b intro+accepts · 2026-08-06 re-lexified 16/48 items onto pool-legal vocabulary (BUILD-DIGEST cloud run 2); modal + teaching point unchanged on every item

items.explanation: After must and should comes the base verb — no to and no -s: must go (not must to go, not must goes).
items.explanation_cz: Po must a should následuje základní tvar — žádné to, žádné -s: must go (ne must to go, ne must goes).

items.explanation: must + base verb = strong necessity. It is the same for every subject — I must, she must, they must, never musts.
items.explanation_cz: must + základní tvar = silná nutnost. Pro všechny osoby stejně — nikdy musts.

items.en: You must wear a suit to the interview.
items.cz: Na pohovor si musíš vzít oblek.
items.gap: You must ____ a suit to the interview. (wear)
accepts: You must wear a suit to the interview.
You must wear a suit for the interview.

items.explanation: must + base verb = strong necessity. It is the same for every subject — I must, she must, they must, never musts.

items.en: I mustn't use my phone here.
items.cz: Tady nesmím používat telefon. (zakázáno / not allowed)
accepts: I mustn't use my phone here.
I must not use my phone here.
items.explanation: mustn't and shouldn't are still modals, so the verb after them stays in the base form: mustn't park, shouldn't drive.
items.explanation_cz: mustn't a shouldn't jsou také modální slovesa — sloveso po nich zůstává v základním tvaru.

items.explanation: mustn't = it is forbidden, not "you don't have to". You mustn't park here means parking is banned.
items.explanation_cz: mustn't = je to zakázáno, ne „nemusíš“. You mustn't park here = parkování je zakázáno.

cards.title: Must / should
cards.body: Modals + base verb. No -s. No to.
cards.body_cz: Modální sloveso + základní tvar. Bez -s. Bez to.
points: must = strong need / rule · should = advice
Not: must to go · Not: shoulds

cards.title: Mustn't
cards.body_cz: mustn't = nesmíš / není dovoleno. Silné ne.
points: Not the same as don't have to (later)

examples.en: You shouldn't eat so much sugar.

cards.title: Questions
points: Yes, you should. / No, you shouldn't.
Must I…? is possible but less common in everyday speech
cards.body: Should is common in questions. Must questions are rarer.
cards.body_cz: Should v otázkách je běžné. Must v otázkách méně.
